name: Cubs Games (Next.js)
author: cubs-games-site
description: Pelican egg for hosting the Cubs Games Next.js application. The server downloads the 2.0 branch from GitHub on each startup, installs dependencies, builds the app, and starts Next.js.
startup: bash -lc 'set -e; cd /mnt/server; archive=/tmp/cubs-games-2.0.tar.gz; rm -f "$archive"; curl -fsSL https://github.com/counterfitninja/cubs-fun2.0/archive/refs/heads/2.0.tar.gz -o "$archive"; rm -rf /tmp/cubs-games-source; mkdir -p /tmp/cubs-games-source; tar -xzf "$archive" -C /tmp/cubs-games-source --strip-components=1; find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name node_modules -exec rm -rf {} +; cp -a /tmp/cubs-games-source/. /mnt/server/; if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi; npm run build; exec npm run start -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}}'

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
archive=/tmp/cubs-games-2.0.tar.gz
rm -f "$archive"
curl -fsSL https://github.com/counterfitninja/cubs-fun2.0/archive/refs/heads/2.0.tar.gz -o "$archive"
rm -rf /tmp/cubs-games-source
mkdir -p /tmp/cubs-games-source
tar -xzf "$archive" -C /tmp/cubs-games-source --strip-components=1
find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name node_modules -exec rm -rf {} +
cp -a /tmp/cubs-games-source/. /mnt/server/
npm ci
npm run build
echo 'Cubs Games installation complete.'
